title: Tech Note: Sending Email from 4th Dimension Version 6.5

historical_commentary.text: Email automation via 4D Internet Commands was cutting-edge in 1999. The Internet Commands plug-in (originally PDM's Internet Toolkit) has been superseded by 4D's built-in SMTP/POP3/IMAP transporter classes introduced in v17+, which provide a modern, object-oriented email API without requiring any plug-in.
related_updates: 4D's built-in SMTP/IMAP/POP3 Transporter classes (v17+) replaced Internet Commands for email
4D Internet Commands plug-in has been deprecated
